subject: stmtctx: use a standalone `RangeFallbackHandler` (#52738)
summary: Refactors statement-level plan-cache tracking and range-fallback handling by introducing standalone, thread-safe `contextutil.PlanCacheTracker` and `contextutil.RangeFallbackHandler`, embedding them into `StatementContext`, and wiring `RangerContext` to depend on these narrower handlers instead of the full `StmtCtx`. Updates planner/expression/executor/session call sites to use the new APIs (`UseCache()`, `PlanCacheUnqualified()`, `SetForcePlanCache`, `SetAlwaysWarnSkipCache`) while preserving existing warning behavior for `EXPLAIN FORMAT = 'plan_cache'`.
